programmes.d: A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.
Framed Texan (Robert Knapp) escapes for showdown with saloonkeeper (Walter Coy).
Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.
The Durango Kid attempts to thwart an outlaw's plot to turn peaceful Indians against neighboring settlers.
A lone cowboy (Ken Maynard) gets the bad guys and wins the gal (Beth Marion).
A rugged rancher (Van Heflin) with good and bad sons can only stop his bad son (Tab Hunter) with a gun.
